title: Gnanora Knowledge API Contract
description: Read surface for the Gnanora Knowledge Platform. Implemented by the mock adapter, the static file adapter, and the live service — all three MUST satisfy this schema. Responses are wrapped in the AGB standard envelope (api-response-schema.json); the definitions here describe the `data` payload only. Source of truth: Confluence UPDS → Knowledge Platform → K3. Domain model: Gnanora Product → G3.

LanguageCode.description: BCP-47 primary subtag. The set is configuration, not a product limit.

StyleId.description: A derived text Explanation. Redefined per AGB-649 — four voice/register options (Simple, Favorite Teacher, Professional/Domain Expert, Friend), documented in gnanora-content's README. Applies to master content only (G4 Part 3).

ExplanationForm.description: G2. Every form carries a text spine (G3/D35).

ExplanationOrigin.description: G2. Only `master` may be style-derived (G4 Part 3).

Anchoring.description: How this Explanation maps onto the master structure, and therefore how reading position survives a switch (G3/D36).

VariantStatus.description: Drives the calm inline generating state in G7. Adapters MUST be able to return every value — a mock that only returns `ready` hides a required UI state.

Visibility.description: Set per Explanation, not per Knowledge (G5/D40).

CalloutVariant.description: What a `callout` block is (AGB-672). `did-you-know`: a surprising fact. `book-note`: the source book's words kept as they are, with what is more accurate (never a silent fix). `mix-up`: a common misunderstanding and the correction. `another-way`: an everyday comparison for a hard idea. `example`: a worked example. The app shows the label for the variant; the text itself is plain.

QaKind.description: What a `qa` block asks for (AGB-672). `check`: a 'Before you start' question whose answer says where to read if unsure. `explain-back`: the learner explains it in their own words, with `listenFor` as the checklist. The rest follow the source book's question types. Absent: an in-section practice question.

Audience.description: Who a block is for (AGB-672). `parent`: the parent guide, shown in the parent view. Absent means `learner`.

RenditionQuality.description: Which device class a media rendition is made for (AGB-672), so a player can pick the right one.

Availability.description: The owner's on/off control for a Knowledge or one of its explanations (AGB-672). Languages and styles not listed are turned off: hidden in the app and skipped by the pipeline. An absent (or empty) list (or an absent `availability`) means every supported one is on.

CatalogRef.description: A link from a Knowledge to a catalog chapter in user management (AGB-672), so a Circle's catalog can point at the content that teaches it.

Block.description: A unit of the text spine. Block IDs are stable across every full-anchored variant — this is what makes position-preserving axis switching possible (G3).

id.description: Stable across styles and languages. A split block emits sub-blocks inheriting this id with a `-1`, `-2` suffix.

text.description: Plain text content. Absent for divider and image blocks. For a `qa` block, the question.

level.description: Heading level. Required when type is `heading` — drives the semantic HTML outline gate (DS9).

items.description: Children of a `list` block, or the key points of a `takeaways` block (each a `listItem`).

alt.description: Accessible description. Required for image blocks (DS10).

sectionId.description: The section this block belongs to. Used for `sectioned` anchoring.

lang.description: Per-block language override for mixed-script content, so screen readers switch pronunciation (DS10).

answer.description: `qa` blocks only: the answer, shown when the learner asks for it. For `answerKind: guidance`, how to approach it rather than one right answer.

ref.description: `qa` blocks only: the source book's own number for the question (e.g. `QT-II.3`, `3.4`), so a learner can match it to their book.

options.description: `qa` blocks only: the choices (two or more), for `mcq` and `odd-one-out`.

answerKind.description: `qa` blocks only. `model`: a model answer. `guidance`: how to approach a question with no single right answer (personal questions, activities). Absent means `model`.

listenFor.description: `qa` blocks with `kind: explain-back` only: what a good explanation includes, as a checklist for the listener (a parent, later the parent dashboard). The same in every style.

sectionRefs.description: `qa` blocks only: the sections that teach this, so a learner who is unsure knows where to read.

MediaRef.description: Indirection over the media layer. Resolves to a managed provider or an in-house pipeline without the client knowing (G18/D28).

url.description: Absolute for a live/CDN-served asset; may be relative to the corpus base for the static-adapter layout, where the corpus is a relocatable file tree that cannot know its own host. Widened from `uri` to `uri-reference` in 2.1.0 — an over-constraint that only went unnoticed while no fixture carried media.

captions.description: Video only. One entry per published language (G18 — captions are mandatory).

quality.description: For one of several renditions of the same media (AGB-672).

Slide.description: A presentation slide. The speaker notes are the text spine (G19).

notesBlockIds.description: Blocks of the spine that narrate this slide.

context.description: Free-text affiliation shown under the name in the picker, e.g. "Class 8B".

styles.description: Derived styles available. Master content only — empty for contributed (G4 Part 3).

voices.description: Voice ids with narration available or generatable.

isDefault.description: The Circle's designated default, or the master when none is set (G19/D41).

availability.description: Overrides the Knowledge's `availability` for this explanation (AGB-672).

sectionId.description: Video explanations only (AGB-672): the section of the text explanation where this clip plays inline.

KnowledgeSummary.description: Card payload for Discover and search results. Deliberately excludes view counts and popularity (G1 principle 6).

Knowledge.description: Knowledge detail with its Explanation index. Master content always exists (G3/D31).

version.description: Master version. All variant cache keys include it (G13 Law 1).

keyConcepts.description: The declared scope a contribution is checked against (G4 Part 2).

discoverable.description: Whether this Knowledge appears in the Discover listing (GET /knowledge). Defaults to true when absent. A Knowledge with discoverable: false is still directly fetchable by id — this only controls listing/aggregation, matching the distinction between the Discover index and a direct knowledge fetch (AGB-649).

explanations.description: Ordered editorially: user's last choice, Circle default, master, then by author (G19).

prerequisites.description: What this Knowledge builds on, in plain words (AGB-672), e.g. 'Living and non-living things'. Its 'Before you start' check questions test these.

ExplanationContent.description: The readable content of one Explanation at one style and language.

blocks.description: Present when status is `ready`. Block ids match the master for full-anchored variants.

media.description: Video or audio form only — the primary media for this Explanation.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when status is `generating`. Client polls after this interval.

fallback.description: Present when status is `unavailable` — the nearest available combination to offer (G7 rule 4).

Narration.description: Generated audio for one (Explanation, Style, Language, Voice) tuple.

marks.description: Block-level time markers. Drives highlight-and-follow and shared read/listen position (G3, G7).

DiscoverIndex.description: Payload for the Discover surface. Editorial ordering only — no trending, no counts (G1 principle 6).

BuddyTerm.description: A key word of the chapter, with its meaning (AGB-672). Shown as a word card when the word is tapped or asked about.

forms.description: Other forms of the word used in the chapter (plurals, verb forms), so they find the same card.

bookNote.description: Where the source book says it differently: the book's words kept as they are, with what is more accurate (as a `book-note` callout does in the text). Never a silent fix.

blockIds.description: The blocks that explain it; the first is where "Read more" goes, and the reader does not mark the word in their sections.

BuddyQuestion.description: A question learners are likely to ask, answered from the chapter (AGB-672).

rephrasings.description: Other ways learners ask the same thing.

blockIds.description: Where in the chapter the answer comes from ("See this in the chapter").

BuddyBank.description: The Curious Buddy's prepared content for one Knowledge in one language (AGB-672): its glossary and likely questions. Served only by the Buddy service, never shipped in the app (`buddy/{knowledgeId}/{lang}.json`).
